# TRU Data

> TRU Data is a website and Android app for buying mobile data bundles in Ghana for MTN, Telecel and AirtelTigo numbers. Customers top up a wallet with Mobile Money and pay for bundles from it; most orders are delivered within minutes.

## What customers can do

- Create a free account and sign in
- Top up the wallet with Mobile Money (MoMo) or an online payment
- Buy MTN, Telecel and AirtelTigo data bundles for any Ghana number
- Follow their orders and receive SMS updates when an order is being processed and delivered
- Install the Android app, or add the site to the iPhone home screen
